name: Hot Ross

features.name: Ro$$ and Hot Ro$$
features.description: Expanding wild cats; Hot Ro$$ also drags neighbouring Ro$$ symbols into full reels.

features.name: Wild multipliers
features.description: Expanding through a wild adds a multiplier of up to 200x.

features.name: Activated reels
features.description: In Nine Lives, a reel that lands Ro$$ keeps landing one every spin.

review:
Ro$$ the cartoon cat from R.I.P. City is back. Regular Ro$$ symbols expand down their reel, while Hot Ro$$ fills the whole reel and pulls Ro$$ symbols on the neighbouring reels up so they expand fully too.

When either expands through a wild, it picks up a multiplier of up to 200x for the whole reel. The Nine Lives bonus adds activated reels where Ro$$ lands every spin – that's where the 15,000x max becomes realistic. Expect long quiet spells between the moments two or three reels catch fire.
